identification: Pro Hart (1928-2006) hand coloured line etching 'His Ghost May Be Heard' (swagman floating in billabong under gums), Waltzing Matilda series, plate signed and dated 'PRO HART 77' in the plate, 127x147 mm, light oak frame with white and slate-grey mats. Lytlewode Press certificate (Robert C. Littlewood, 15 Dec 2011): Series 1 No. 30, edition 100, 'This is a Publisher's Proof Unsigned', from his collection of printer's proofs. Not pencil signed by Hart. Page estimate A$50-70.
